I am 53 years old, farmed 30 years here in Quzhou, and finished middle school. I can read fertilizer bags and figure my costs, but my real teachers are my fields and my neighbors. I run 31.5 mu total: 24 mu in wheat-maize double cropping and 7.5 mu in zucchini. My son works off-farm in Handan and sends money home, but I watch every yuan on this farm. I would rather spend a little too much on fertilizer than lose yield — a bad harvest is a disaster, but wasting half a bag of urea is just a cost.

My winter wheat is already in the ground. Last October I sowed 15 kg per mu of an improved variety. At sowing I put down one 50 kg bag of 15-15-15 compound fertilizer per mu — that is about 7 kg each of nitrogen, phosphorus, and potassium. At green-up in March I spread 20 kg of urea per mu, and I will topdress another 15 kg per mu at jointing right now. I figure that puts my nitrogen around 20 kg per mu total. I will irrigate three times from now through harvest: green-up, jointing, and grain filling. Water from the well costs electricity, but dry wheat is dead wheat. I spray twice: herbicide once at green-up and fungicide once at heading. I expect 550 kg per mu if the weather holds.

After wheat harvest in early June, I no-till plant hybrid maize straight into the stubble. I learned that from my neighbor — saves diesel and time. I use 3 kg of hybrid seed per mu, about 50 yuan, but it gives me good ears. I put one 50 kg bag of compound fertilizer per mu at sowing, then topdress 25 kg urea at big trumpet stage. That comes to about 18 kg nitrogen, 6 kg phosphorus, and 6 kg potassium per mu. I irrigate twice: big trumpet and grain filling, if the rain does not come. I spray three times: herbicide after emergence, then insecticide twice for corn borers. I expect 650 kg per mu.

For zucchini on my 7.5 mu, I plant hybrid seeds in spring. Vegetables need more work and more food. I rotary till and put down 2 cubic meters of chicken manure per mu, plus 75 kg of compound fertilizer as base. During fruiting I topdress urea and potassium sulfate. Total nutrients run about 22 kg nitrogen, 9 kg phosphorus, and 18 kg potassium per mu. I irrigate 8 times through the season — zucchini cannot dry out. I spray pesticide 5 times for aphids and powdery mildew. I hope for 4000 kg per mu. Zucchini prices jump around, but when the price is good it beats grain by a lot. Fertilizer is expensive this year — urea is 120 yuan per 50 kg bag, compound is 160 yuan — but I am not changing what works.
